name: @kilrkrow/netscript
description: A diagram-as-code DSL and renderer for physical network & infrastructure topology — clean, Visio-grade SVG from a declarative model.

scripts.render:examples: node src/cli.ts --example three-rack --theme blueprint -o examples/three-rack-blueprint.svg && node src/cli.ts --example three-rack --theme clean -o examples/three-rack-clean.svg && node src/cli.ts --example three-rack --theme blueprint --projection iso -o examples/three-rack-iso.svg && node src/cli.ts examples/homelab-logical.net --theme blueprint-hybrid -o examples/homelab-logical.svg && node src/cli.ts examples/sql-traffic.net --view traffic -o examples/sql-traffic.svg && node src/cli.ts examples/sql-traffic.net --view traffic --projection iso -o examples/sql-traffic-iso.svg && node src/cli.ts examples/service-stack.net --view traffic -o examples/service-stack.svg && node src/cli.ts examples/service-stack.net --view traffic --projection iso -o examples/service-stack-iso.svg && node src/cli.ts examples/ethernet-tube.net -o examples/ethernet-tube.svg && node src/cli.ts examples/ethernet-tube.net --theme blueprint-hybrid -o examples/ethernet-tube-blueprint.svg

author: kilrkrow
